titleTr: Okul ofisini aramak: kibar dolaylı sorular

grammar.topic: Indirect polite questions: Could you tell me...?
explainTr: Kibar konuşmak için doğrudan soru yerine 'Could you tell me...?', 'Do you know...?' ya da 'I was wondering if...' ile başlarsın. Doğrudan soru: Where is the office? Dolaylı soru: Could you tell me where the office is?
En önemli kural: soru kelimesinden sonra düz cümle sırası kullanırsın (özne + fiil) ve do/does/did gelmez: Do you know what time school starts? (does school start değil). Fiil gerekirse -s alır.
Evet/hayır sorularında 'if' ya da 'whether' kullanırsın: Do you know if the office is open? Cümle soru kalıbıyla başlıyorsa sonunda soru işareti kalır.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede kibar soru için sözcük sırası değişmez: 'Ofis nerede?' / 'Ofisin nerede olduğunu söyler misiniz?'. İngilizcede ise yardımcı fiil (is, does) özneden önce gelmemeli: where the office is, not where is the office.
table: Could you tell me where the office is?
Do you know if the office is open?
Do you know what time does school start?

reading.title: A call to the school office
reading.text:
Hafsa is nervous about phone calls in English because she cannot see the other person's face. Today, however, she needs information about substitute teacher registration. Before she calls, she writes her questions on a card and checks the word order twice.

"Lincoln Elementary, this is Mr. Brown," says the voice on the phone. Hafsa takes a deep breath. "Good morning, Mr. Brown. This is Hafsa. Could you tell me what time the office closes?" "We close at four thirty," he answers. "Thank you. I was wondering if there is a fee for registration." "Yes, the fee is thirty dollars, and the deadline is next Friday."

Hafsa writes the numbers down quickly. "Do you know whether the principal is available on Thursday? I would like to ask her a few questions about the school's policy for substitutes." Mr. Brown looks at his list. "She is free at ten o'clock. Shall I put your name down?" "Yes, please. And could you tell me how I can reach you if I am late?" He gives her his direct number and his email address.

When she hangs up, Hafsa smiles. The call was short, polite and clear. She realizes that she does not need perfect English to get what she wants. She only needs the right question order. She puts the card in her wallet. On the back she writes, "Could you tell me ...? Do you know if ...?" It will be useful again soon.

listening.title: A phone call before the first day

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Good afternoon, Mr. Brown. This is Hafsa. I was wondering if you could tell me where I should park on Monday.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Sure. You can park behind the gym. Do you know where it is?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes, I do. Could you also tell me what time I should arrive?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Please be here by seven thirty. The first bell rings at eight.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Thank you. Do you know if I need to bring anything?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Just your ID and a pen. We provide the lesson plans.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: One more question. Could you tell me whether students eat lunch in the classroom?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: No, they eat in the cafeteria at eleven forty-five.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: That's very helpful. Do you mind if I call again if I have more questions?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Not at all. Call any time before four thirty.

writing.promptTr: Okul ofisine ilk günün hakkında kibar bir e-posta yaz. En az 4 dolaylı soru kullan: Could you tell me...? I was wondering if...? Do you know whether...? (80-120 kelime)
writing.promptEn: Write a polite email to the school office about your first day. Use at least four indirect questions. (80-120 words)
frames: Could you tell me what time ...?
Could you also tell me where ...?
writing.model: Dear Mr. Brown, I am writing to ask a few questions about my first day. Could you tell me what time I should arrive on Monday? I was wondering if I need to bring a lesson plan or if the school provides one. Do you know whether I can park behind the gym? Could you also tell me where I should go first when I arrive? I would also like to know how I can reach you if I am late. Thank you very much for your help. I am looking forward to working at Lincoln Elementary. Sincerely, Hafsa
checklistTr: Dolaylı sorularda düz cümle sırası kullandın mı (where the office is)?

Evet/hayır sorularında if ya da whether var mı?
Soru işareti yalnızca ana soru cümlesinin sonunda mı?
